Can you confirm the full account number to provide last 4 digits for internal matching? If you prefer, you can redact the middle digits on a scanned letter and include a signer name at the bottom.

3) Invoice remit / PO acceptance: Please confirm the remit address above and whether invoices should be sent to invoices@glistenlabs.com or to the remit address on the W-9. Also confirm whether you accept purchase orders via email or require EDI.

4) Master agreement: If you have a signed master services agreement (MSA) or procurement terms we should store, please attach. Otherwise, we can send our standard MPA for signature.

I've attached our vendor intake form (vendor_intake_form.xlsx) — filling the account contact and signer fields will speed activation. Once AP confirms the bank letter and legal name, David will create the master record and route the first PO.

- Bank letter: We need the bank letter on bank letterhead with bank phone and a printed name + title of the bank signatory. The account number can be redacted except for the last 4 digits (we store last 4 only).

- Remit address: we will route invoices to invoices@glistenlabs.com by default. If you must have physical mail to the address on file, please confirm and we will add it as secondary.
- Payment terms: Redwood default is Net-45 for vendors in this category. If you require Net-60, confirm now and we will flag it for review (may require finance approval).
- Tax docs: W-9 provided — if Glisten Labs is a foreign entity, we would need W-8BEN; please confirm US tax status.

If you can return the bank letter with the signatory name and confirm the last 4 digits match, we'll mark "bank_verified" in our system and David will activate the vendor master. Also please provide the authorized signer for the MPA and their email so we can send the DocuSign envelope.
